Hi!

I wanted to break free from watching my laptop screen for long Claude sessions partially due to degrading eyesight and have a sidekick for approvals streamed to the Kobo. I ended up building that, a SDK and full app store for Kobo.

Introducing Cobalt - an Android like platform for Kobo to develop apps and enable reading more things than books.

We read a lot more things than books daily: forums, long form articles, research papers, Coding agents logs etc.

If you really need these, usually the way is to search, download, convert elsewhere like a laptop and then sideload on the eInk display. Cobalt makes it much easier.
